title: Urticaria / Angioedema Workup
subtitle: Anaphylaxis, acute urticaria, chronic urticaria, and bradykinin angioedema

steps.prompt: Airway compromise, hypotension, wheeze, GI symptoms, or anaphylaxis concern?
Are wheals present with or without angioedema?
Duration less than 6 weeks or recurrent beyond 6 weeks?
Acute urticaria: trigger review and antihistamine pathway
Chronic spontaneous/inducible urticaria pathway with limited labs
Angioedema without wheals: ACE inhibitor, hereditary/acquired C1-INH pathway

citations.quote: International urticaria guideline covers definition, classification, diagnosis, and management of urticaria with wheals, angioedema, or both.
StatPearls Angioedema review summarizes histaminergic and bradykinin-mediated angioedema evaluation.
